purpose: Audit component contributions to the fixed own sequence-adapter model; do not select a replacement winner on the historical test set.

endpoint.thresholds: train median activity and positive-margin 90th percentile
endpoint.dtype: float32 labels and predictions; inclusive comparisons; no epsilon

adapter_family.base: exact published t2_res_stage seed-specific checkpoint, frozen

definitions.no_pair_rank: zero coefficient on the adapter's 0.5 pair-ranking loss; retain identical sampled pairs and forward passes
definitions.no_qc_product: zero the q*context input slice; keep q, context, dimensions and initial weights
definitions.linear_update: replace 0.25*tanh(logit) with 0.25*logit; identical derivative and output at zero initialization
definitions.shared_query: form adapter query from unconditioned residue pairs; retain enzyme-conditioned pair states and readout

adapter_family.limits: Context in the sequence arm is learned shared context, not numerical geometry; no_qc_product is a parameterization test, not proof of biological contacts. Existing no-adapter predictions are reused, not counted as a new training run.

stages: train task backbone with frozen ESM features and no task-LM branch
add the same pretrained task LM as a residual, freeze inherited tensors for 10 epochs then unfreeze
freeze selected task backbone and fit the sequence adapter
backbone_family.initialization: Regenerate the same seeded task-layer initialization for every arm; use identical frozen ESM features, enzyme descriptors and pretrained task-LM initialization. Apply the deletion in every training stage, not only at inference or after a full-model checkpoint was trained.

definitions.full: matched complete three-stage retraining control, separate from the previously selected winning checkpoints
definitions.no_esm: zero the peptide ESM feature branch before fusion in every stage; enzyme descriptors are retained
definitions.no_task_lm: zero the task-LM residual in every stage
definitions.no_lookup: zero the position-specific residue lookup before fusion in every stage
definitions.no_film: zero enzyme FiLM scale/shift; retain enzyme descriptors for cosine readout
definitions.no_pairs: zero residue-pair features before the shared trunk in every stage; adapter is mathematically inactive and is not claimed as separately trained
definitions.additive_pairs: replace ReLU(W_i e_i + W_j e_j + b) by ReLU(W_i e_i + b/2)+ReLU(W_j e_j + b/2), retaining exactly the same parameter shapes; tests local nonlinear pair mixing, not all higher-order interactions
definitions.no_metric: zero the cosine-readout contribution; retain the linear activity readout
definitions.activity_only: train all stages on raw activity MSE, zero pair-ranking loss; keep common validation checkpoint criterion and inference selector

backbone_family.capacity: Deletion arms retain nominal parameter shapes to preserve shared initialization; report gradient-active parameters separately. Additive_pairs is the same-parameter-count interaction control.
backbone_family.limits: Compare each deletion to the newly retrained full model under the same protocol. Do not substitute historical winning numbers as the matched training control. Activity_only isolates the gradient objective; the common validation criterion and downstream selector are still used.

training.base_loss: mean activity MSE + 36 centred-profile MSE + 2 hard-margin MSE + 0.5 final-profile pair-ranking
training.checkpoint_criterion: validation mean activity MSE + 36 centred-profile MSE + 2 hard-margin MSE; no test-selected checkpoint
training.new_phase_rng: same per-seed minibatch/pair sampler and global dropout seed across arms; original checkpoints are separately replayed

execution.on_failure: record traceback and continue independent arms; failed arms remain failed and do not count as completed
execution.resume: completed stages skipped only if immutable run signature matches
execution.test_use: test predictions are exported only after an arm's checkpoints are frozen; no result-driven changes to the registered arms

interpretation: Report all 18 targets and all 3 seeds, including zero/negative effects. Observed whole-pipeline superiority does not by itself prove a component is necessary or eliminates shortcuts. Historical test set remains retrospective.
